question: Can I have my own independent repair facility perform warranty repairs?
answer: No. Only authorized YADEA dealers are allowed to perform warranty work on your YADEA product.

question: How do I get my vehicle repaired while in warranty?
answer: In order to obtain warranty coverage, the first step is to take your vehicle to an authorized YADEA dealer for diagnosis. Your dealer will determine if there is warranty coverage. Please see the Dealer Locator to find the dealer closest to you.

question: How do I know when to have my YADEA product serviced?
answer: Please see the maintenance section of your owner’s manual. The service intervals in the maintenance schedule are based on average riding conditions. Some items will need more frequent service if you ride in severe conditions or at full throttle. Consult your dealer for recommendations applicable to your individual needs and use.

question: How do I know where to have my YADEA product serviced?
answer: Any of our authorized service dealers will service your YADEA machine. Check out our dealer locator to find the dealer nearest you.

question: Where are YADEA vehicles made?
answer: YADEA is a global manufacturer based in Wuxi, China.

question: Where is my nearest dealer?
answer: You can find your nearest dealer by using our dealer locator tool.

question: Where can I buy parts?
answer: Parts can be purchased through any of our authorized YADEA dealers.

question: Where can I get my owner’s manual?
answer: When purchased new, all of our vehicles come with an owner’s manual. If you’ve misplaced or damaged your original owner’s manual, contact your YADEA dealer and they will be able to order you a replacement, or you can find digital versions of most of our owner’s manuals here.

question: Where can I get my service manual?
answer: When purchased new, all of our vehicles come with an owner’s manual. If you would like additional information on servicing your vehicle, you can order a service manual through a YADEA dealer. Find your nearest dealer here.

question: I have a technical question. Should I call the YADEA headquarters?
answer: All questions technical and non-technical should be directed to your local YADEA dealer, who is the best resource for timely and accurate information.
